def get_interface_to_target(self, target: IPv4Address) -> Optional[IPv4Interface]:
    """
    Gets an interface on the local machine that can be reached by the target machine
    """
    # Use `network_interfaces` to get the interface
    interface = network_interfaces.get_interface_to_target(str(target))
    return IPv4Interface(interface) if interface else None
